content: {"reasoning":"The CO-197 denial remains after submission with records and a medical-necessity appeal, and this payer offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review. The claim data are valid, so correction or another unchanged submission would not resolve the missing authorization. CO-197 assigns the denied amount to provider responsibility; the remaining deductible alone does not establish a billable patient share, and there is no secondary payer or supported recovery path.","action":"write_off"}
